content_sections.heading: CUH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the CUH Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download CUH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 7 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant, 3 for Field Investigator and 3 for Casual Research Staff.

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Post Graduate in any Social Science discipline with minimum 55% marks. Preference to NET/M.Phil/Ph.D. Field Investigator: Graduate in any social science discipline with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade. Preference to four-year graduation programme. Casual Research Staff: Graduation in any stream.

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: ₹37,000/- Per Month (Consolidated) Field Investigator: ₹20,000/- Per Month (Consolidated) Casual Research Staff: ₹2,000/- Per Day (Consolidated)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CUH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUH recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the CUH Research Assistant, Field Investigator, and Casual Research Staff posts is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the posts of Research Assistant, Field Investigator, and Casual Research Staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CUH recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Field Investigator post is a Graduate degree in any social science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the CUH recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected Research Assistant will receive a consolidated salary of ₹37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Central University of Haryana located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Haryana is located in Mahendergarh, Haryana, with the pincode 123031.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, so candidates from other states are likely eligible if they meet the criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for easy access.
